crossing_rules.crest: signed distance to finite crest top; count first passage and every later signed recrossing separately
crossing_rules.return: same physical line with negative direction; do not relabel a repeated crossing as new fluid
crossing_rules.right_censoring: unseen events at 16 s are censored, not zero and not failed transport
crossing_rules.surface: finite free-surface/run-up line crossing from z below to z above with linear interpolation between native saved frames

phases.semantics: initial fluid and finite boundaries before measurable incident wave
prescribed piston input; no output truncation
wave reaches upstream gauges and slope toe in chronological order
free surface climbs the continuous slope; peak run-up is recorded
weir crest crossing and lateral-slot passage; right-censored if not reached
downslope retreat, reverse toe crossing and downstream residence
final category, unknown mass and boundary/closure budget
